{{recipe}}

'''Poundo yam''' is a [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallow]] made from [[Cookbook:Yam|yam]] flour. It is similar to [[Cookbook:Pounded Yam|pounded yam]]; however, this version is made with yam flour and does not require a mortar and pestle. It can be served with [[Cookbook:Efo Riro (Nigerian Amaranth Soup)|ẹfọ riro]], [[Cookbook:Ogbono Soup|ogbono soup]], or [[Cookbook:Egusi Soup|ẹgusi soup]].

==Ingredients==
*Water
*[[Cookbook:Yam|Yam]] flour

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water using a pot.
#While stirring slowly, pour yam flour until the mixture is lump-free and smooth.
#Add a small quantity of water and cook for few minutes.
#Serve with the soup of your choice.
